_description: Export this file from the tracker UI using 'Export JSON'. Commit it to sync your progress to the repo. This is a template showing the data shape — your actual data lives in your browser's localStorage until you export.
_workflow: 2. Log your daily progress (status, hours, DSA, notes)
7. git add tracker/data/progress.json && git commit && git push

days._comment: Keys are day numbers (1-180). Values are per-day progress records.

courses._comment: Keys are course IDs from courses.json. Values: todo|in-progress|done

patterns._comment: Keys are pattern IDs from leetcode.json. Values: 0-4 (mastery level)

portfolio._comment: Keys are artifact IDs from artifacts.json proofChecklist. Values: true|false

miniProjects._comment: Keys are week numbers 1-18. Values: true|false

aiArtifacts._comment: Keys are week numbers 1-18. Values: true|false

aiReadiness._comment: Keys are AI readiness category IDs from readiness.json. Values: 0-5 (score)

systemDesign._comment: Keys are topic IDs from system-design.json. Values: true|false (drilled)
